# Collider audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/collider-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set collider` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `tunnel.mp3` is cut from "drone natural tunnel office building ventilation bass2.flac" by kyles, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/kyles/sounds/452223/.
- `racks.mp3` is cut from "070916 Machine room server rack fans 3.wav" by thaighaudio, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/thaighaudio/sounds/349689/.
- `pump.mp3` is cut from "oxygen concentrator close prospect.flac" by kb7clx, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/kb7clx/sounds/378147/.
